PropTypeDefault
dataas aboverequired
valueFn(&T) -> f64required
groupFn(&T) -> &str: one lane and colour per groupone lane
point_sizef32, pixels5.
x_axisAxisConfigAxisConfig::new()
legend, tooltip, classas on <XYChart>

Every value is a dot at its exact x. Dots that would overlap are pushed up or down within their lane, so the lane's outline is the shape of the distribution.

examples.title: Treatment groups
examples.description: Every value as a dot, pushed apart so none overlap.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn groups() {
    let data = use_signal(measures(
        &[
            ("Control", 50., 8.),
            ("Dose 1", 56., 9.),
            ("Dose 2", 63., 7.),
        ],
        70,
    ));
    rsx! { <Beeswarm data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} group={|m: &Measure| m.group} class="h-72" /> }
}

examples.title: One group
examples.code:
#[component]
fn single() {
    let data = use_signal(measures(&[("", 120., 25.)], 150));
    rsx! { <Beeswarm data={data} value={|m: &Measure| m.value} point_size={4.} x_axis={AxisConfig::new().label("Response time (ms)")} class="h-56" /> }
}
